|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[R'tic H'weei (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-rtichweei-2020-10-14.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-rtichweei-2020-10-14-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-rtichweei-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-D-rtichweei-2020-10-14-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-rtichweei-2020-10-14.gif]], 14 October 2020).
* '''Original''' ([[R'tic H'weei]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-rtichweei022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/rtichweei.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/rtichweei.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Daroe”. Text: “Once per game, may take one Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or gametext into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 14 October 2020<ref name="img-rtichweeid5f24d6">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/rtichweei.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d5f24d6dd023e0aba39bc2f530e19465496ebf25 commit d5f24d6] (14 October 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/rtichweei.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “may take one Jawa Blaster” → “may take Jawa Blaster”; “title or gametext into hand” → “title or game text into hand”; “Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, if” → “Deck; reshuffle. During opponent's turn, if”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the PC re-made the image at lower resolution (350×490 → 345×486 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Daroe”. Text: “Once per game, may take Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During opponent's turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[R'tic H'weei (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-rtichweeiab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/rtichweei.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/rtichweei.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the bottom margin “•Daroe” → “Daroe” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (345×486 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Daroe”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Once per game, may take Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During opponent's turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.”
